title: Leina le le Neilweng Pele ga Botsalo
intro: Akanya ka lefelo le le boitshepo le le didimetseng le le tletseng mekokotlelo e e tlhoafetseng morago ga go leta ka dingwaga tse dintsi. Go tswa mo go se se sa bonweng go tswa karabo e e tshotseng leina le le iseng le ko le newe pele, e solofetsa botlhale go tswa mo dingwageng tsa ntlha le botshelo jo bo tshwailweng ka boineelo, kutlwelobotlhoko le bophepa.
clues: Ke ne ka bidiwa ke Allah ka boene pele ga ke tsholwa, ka leina le le iseng le ko le newe ope pele ga me.
Ke ne ka newa e le karabo ya kopo e e tlhoafetseng ke batsadi ba ba godileng ba ba neng ba akanya gore go ka se kgonege go nna le bana.
Ke ne ka newa botlhale, katlholo le Lekwalo ke sa ntse ke le monnye.
Ke ne ke dira maikarabelo mo batsading ba me e bile ke utlwela ba bangwe botlhoko, e bile ke ne ke sa ikgogomose kgotsa ke sa utlwe.
Allah o laetse kagiso mo go nna ka letsatsi le ke tsetsweng ka lone, letsatsi le ke swang ka lone, le letsatsi le ke tla tsosiwang ke tshela ka lone.
Rre Zakariyya o ne a amogela dikgang tse di itumedisang ka nna go tswa mo baengeleng fa a ne a eme ka thapelo mo lefelong le le boitshepo (mihrab).

trial.label: Tshegofatso le Teko
options: Go mediwa ke tlhapi e kgolo ka ntlha ya go tsamaya ka bogale
A latlhelwa mo molelong o o tukang ka ntlha ya go thubaganya medingwana
O ne a ganwa bonno mme a tlogelwa gore a godisiwe ke phiri e namagadi
E newa batsadi ba ba godileng morago ga mokokotlelo o o tlhoafetseng
O ne a lebana le Faro mme a etelela pele khudugo go kgabaganya lewatle
trial.answer: E newa batsadi ba ba godileng morago ga mokokotlelo o o tlhoafetseng

location.label: Lefelo la Botlhokwa
options: Lefelo le le boitshepo (mihrab) le go neng go itsisiwe dikgang tse di itumedisang mo go lone
Molelo o o tukang o o baakantsweng ke baobamedi ba medingwana
Mpa ya tlhapi e kgolo mo lewatleng le le boteng
Logaga lo batho ba ba neng ba robetse ba neng ba ikhutsa mo go lone ka makgolokgolo a dingwaga
Mokgatšha wa ditshoswane mo mogwantong wa segosi
location.answer: Lefelo le le boitshepo (mihrab) le go neng go itsisiwe dikgang tse di itumedisang mo go lone

outcome.label: Tlotlo ya Bomodimo
options: E latlhetswe kwa loaping ke matlapa a letsopa le le bakilweng
A mediwa ke lefatshe a tshela ka ntlha ya boikgogomoso jwa letlotlo
E sentswe ke go thunya ga maru ka ntlha ya go kgaola kamela e namagadi
O nwetse le moamogedi yo o mabela mo lewatleng le le kgaoganeng
Kgotso mo go nna letsatsi le ke tsetsweng ka lone, letsatsi le ke suleng ka lone, le letsatsi le ke tsosiwang ke tshela ka lone
outcome.answer: Kgotso mo go nna letsatsi le ke tsetsweng ka lone, letsatsi le ke suleng ka lone, le letsatsi le ke tsosiwang ke tshela ka lone

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
